title: Contrasting structural and functional adaptations in soil bacterial communities underlie multi-metal remediation by biochar versus nano zero-valent iron-loaded biochar
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EN00031B, Paper
Peipei Song, Xiaoyu Gao
It provides the comprehensive comparison of BC and nZVI@BC in remediation of Pb, As, Cu, Cd and Zn co-contaminated soil, with a particular focus on their effects on soil bacterial community structure and function.
